title: NOC_CONTENT_Y is a fixed 116px but the top band it must clear is hud()-scaled — the 'content starts below the top band' invariant only holds at UI scale x1.00
evidence:
+NOC_CONTENT_Y     :: 116            // the first content row's y (below the top band)
...diff context showing the band is hud-scaled...
 	forecast_left := v.win_w - hud(v, 230) - hud(v, 10) // the forecast panel's left edge
 	title_h := hud(v, 20)
 	line_h := hud(v, 17)
...and the PR body...
+- **The rail never covers the top-band HUD cards**: the draw order flips to world → rail → HUD — the health card, forecast panel, pause chip and crisis banner paint OVER the plate; the rail's own content starts below the top band (`NOC_CONTENT_Y` = 116 — the health card bottom 74, forecast ~104).
detail: The 74/104px band measurements are x1.00 numbers; the knob scales the top band (hud() used throughout, x1.50 is a tested config). At x1.50 the forecast bottom is ~156 > 116, so it paints over the rail's first rows. No test pins CONTENT_Y against a scaled band.
recommended_fix: Derive NOC_CONTENT_Y from the hud-scaled top-band bottom (or pin a test at x1.25/x1.50 asserting the first content row clears it).

evidence:

...
 	fit := rnd.camera_fit(v) // ONE source (Perkins r2 N1 — the derivation was triplicated)
 	v.scale = fit * app.cam_zoom
+	v.off_x = f32(v.play_w)/2 - app.cam_wx * v.scale
detail: view_set_rail flips play_w immediately and camera_update applies the new fit directly (fit drops from 720/780 to 756/1040 at 1280x720 per the pinned numbers). Only cam_zoom/cam_wx are eased; the rail transition itself snaps.
recommended_fix: Ease the playfield transition (animate play_w or the fit) or document the snap as an accepted ruling.

title: view_set_rail has no lower bound — windows narrower than NOC_RAIL_W yield negative play_w and a negative camera fit
detail: If win_w < 524 while D is on (a shrunk window; the resize handler re-applies the rail unconditionally), play_w goes negative, camera_fit goes negative, and scale/off invert. No clamp or minimum-window guard appears in the diff.
recommended_fix: Clamp play_w to a positive floor (e.g. max(1, win_w - NOC_RAIL_W)) or gate the rail on a minimum window width.
